method: run.sh.txt ran each reasoner once per input and compared its taxonomy with the classifier's (gen-ours.sh.txt wrote those) and, for the range cases, with HermiT's, through scripts/el-oracle.py. The first range and big pass of Whelk failed in the harness, which commit 91a7b160 fixed, and the batch then ran Whelk again with ONLY=whelk, so env.txt lists three starts. The robot stage timed each ROBOT command with timed.py.txt from the release's RDF/XML file, or from the functional-style file for the -ofn rows, to the written functional-style output, and checked each output's asserted named hierarchy with el-oracle.py --asserted against the classifier's taxonomy. The batch's sparkles runs failed because the release binary had been removed from the build directory, so the four sparkles-classify rows of robot/runs.jsonl after the failed ones ran afterwards with the same binary under the same cap.
scale: Four range test ontologies, GO 2026-07-26, ChEBI lite 256 and the 298 ORE 2015 EL classification ontologies

settings.memory_cap: MemoryMax=12G and no swap per run
settings.whelk_heap: 1g for the range cases, 10g for GO and ChEBI lite, 16 MiB of heap per MiB of file plus 2 GiB, at most 10g, for ORE
